description: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "4AEABB4F4972564584C3AE977C027E0B", "During eclipses, when the light dimmed and tension thickened, you led rites woven from Vek and Nikua ballads.
